description: Invesco QQQ Trust is an exchange-traded fund that tracks the Nasdaq-100 Index, a market-capitalisation-weighted index of the 100 largest non-financial companies listed on the NASDAQ exchange. Heavily concentrated in mega-cap technology and AI-adjacent companies — Apple, Microsoft, Nvidia, Alphabet, Amazon, Meta, Tesla, and Broadcom collectively represent more than half the fund's weight — QQQ functions as the primary liquid proxy for institutional and retail exposure to U.S. large-cap growth, AI infrastructure buildout, and semiconductor cycles. It is the third-largest ETF in the world by assets under management.
